The Adjudication

The Panel
& Prizes

Shortlisted creators will pitch live at Faith Nexus 2026 to a panel of experts including:

Media Leaders
Investors & Philanthropists
Technologists
Ministry Strategists

Prizes Include:

  • Seed funding or production support
  • Mentorship from experienced industry professionals
  • A feature on NexTalks or other Faith Nexus media
  • Visibility through global partner networks
The Cinema Hub

Faith Nexus
Storytellers Showcase

We will curate and screen 5–10 outstanding short films or series pilots that carry strong Gospel, justice or redemptive themes. Experience Kingdom storytelling in its most powerful visual form.

Selected Projects will:

  • Be screened during a special Storytellers Showcase
  • Receive recognition on stage as Faith Nexus Storytellers
  • Be featured across our media channels and partner networks
  • Be eligible for additional visibility via FaithNexus100
